description: This source file contains the implementation of an abstract codec class for serializing enum types with 32-bit values, along with specific serializers for DateTimeKind and DayOfWeek enums, utilizing Orleans serialization infrastructure.

classes.name: Enum32BaseCodec<T>
classes.description: Abstract generic serializer for 32-bit enum types, providing methods for writing and reading enum values.

classes.name: DateTimeKindCodec
classes.description: Serializer for DateTimeKind enum, inheriting from Enum32BaseCodec.

classes.name: DayOfWeekCodec
classes.description: Serializer for DayOfWeek enum, inheriting from Enum32BaseCodec.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes an enum value by converting it to an int32 and writing it to the writer.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes an int32 and converts it back to the enum type.
